paragraphs.source_en: By the time the three of them emerged north of the Wall the snow was falling steadily. A ragged blanket of white covered the torn and tortured earth that stretched from the Wall to the edge of the haunted forest. Jon Snow and his black brothers were gathered around three spears, some twenty yards away.

units.source_en: By the time the three of them emerged north of the Wall the snow was falling steadily.
A ragged blanket of white covered the torn and tortured earth that stretched from the Wall to the edge of the haunted forest.
Jon Snow and his black brothers were gathered around three spears, some twenty yards away.

paragraphs.source_en: The spears were eight feet long and made of ash. The one on the left had a slight crook, but the other two were smooth and straight. At the top of each was impaled a severed head. Their beards were full of ice, and the falling snow had given them white hoods. Where their eyes had been, only empty sockets remained, black and bloody holes that stared down in silent accusation.
